roles.name: Programmer
roles.description: Builds and fixes client software. As support, automates the dull parts of your contracts so you get more time.

roles.name: Security Analyst
roles.description: Runs audits for clients. As support, raises what you are paid for audits and incident work.

roles.name: Network Engineer
roles.description: Keeps client networks alive. As support, finds you new offers faster and raises network analysis pay.

roles.name: Reverse Engineer
roles.description: Takes things apart for a living. As support, raises pay for malware and recovery work.

roles.name: AI Engineer
roles.description: Trains models for clients. As support, helps you learn faster from every contract and adds research power.

roles.name: System Administrator
roles.description: Keeps everything running and everything logged. As support, keeps your tracks tidy so underground work raises less heat.
